knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The guide asks that the test methods be proven before the cleaning study starts. The remaining options are unrelated or wrong.
Consecutive successful runs show the method is reliable. A single run could succeed by chance.
Sampling procedure, locations and the reason for the method are all expected in the protocol.

practicalCriteria: Learner drafts the protocol headings for one item and fills in each element from the lesson (pass: all listed elements present).
Learner identifies the step that must happen before the study is run (pass: approval and validated methods named).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Draft protocol outline for one item
stopWorkCriteria: The learner is asked to run a study before the protocol is approved.
The test methods cannot be shown to perform.
